// diagnostic E0974

Jet.EveryFieldTargetInvalid

`#EveryField(of: T)` target is not a checkable struct

What

`#EveryField(of: T)` target is not a checkable struct

Why

`#EveryField(of: T)` checks every stored field of a single struct visible to the function — non-struct types have no struct fields, inaccessible private fields cannot be verified, and duplicate markers for the same struct conflict

Fix

Name a struct type whose stored fields are all visible in this module, once per `#EveryField` marker.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.EveryFieldTargetInvalid: Tests/UI/every_field_duplicate.stderr.

Error: Jet.EveryFieldTargetInvalid: Duplicate `#EveryField` marker for `Order`
  --> Tests/UI/every_field_duplicate.jet:7:1
    |
  7 | #EveryField(of: Order)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Each struct needs at most one `#EveryField` marker on a function
 Fix: Remove the duplicate `#EveryField` marker
